## Given Case
- Case Subject: Size Mismatch for Explorer Outdoor Jacket
- Case Description: I recently purchased the Explorer Outdoor Jacket, but the size chart on the website does not match the actual size of the jacket I received. I ordered a medium based on the chart, but it fits more like a large. This is very frustrating as I need the jacket for an upcoming trip and don't have time for an exchange.
